text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - API Gateway 502/504 spike detected (ingress -> gateway). Alerting current on-call.

alice_oncall: seeing increased 502/504 across eu-west and us-east. 10-20% error rate on /v1/generate, traffic surge ~3x. :rotating_light:

ben_sre: confirmed. Edge logs show rapid 502 fanout from mux-pool-3 -> gateway-proxy-1. TCP RSTs + upstream 504s.

carla_prod: customers reporting failed requests in analytics dashboard. Not seeing large latency increase before errors, seems immediate 502.

alice_oncall: paging ben now. @ben_sre can you grab network + proxy traces? I'll start customer impact assessment.

ben_sre: on it. pulling `nginx` + `gateway-proxy` logs. running `kubectl logs -n gateway gateway-proxy-1 --since=10m`

ben_sre: logs show repeated `501/502 backend unreachable` from backend pool `inference-runtime`. Downstream pods show `OOMKilled` on some nodes and `504` on others. Looks like a mix of backend saturation + intermittent TCP drops.

dave_runtime: jumping in — we had a rolling autoscaler policy hit threshold on quantized-model-nodes; some nodes failed health checks during a config push ~15m ago. I suspect a partial rollout of the new kernel path triggered memory pressure.

maya_support: triaging customer reports. Top 3 affected customers: acme-inc (high-volume chat), shoply (embeddings batch), trimesh (internal eval). Notified account teams.

carla_prod: estimate impact: 6% of overall requests 502/504, but for some routes (long-seq gen) failure is 40%.

alice_oncall: ok mitigation plan: 1) circuit-break gateway to fallback pool (route to read-only cached-model variants) 2) pause autoscaler rollouts 3) scale up healthy runtime nodes and evict OOM pods 4) notify status and customers. Who owns step 1?

ben_sre: can take 1. Applying temporary routing rule now: `route /v1/generate -> gateway-fallback-pool` with weight 80:20 fallback. Executing.

ben_sre: `kubectl apply -f /tmp/fallback-route.yaml` -> route change propagated to edge. Observing drop in 502s at edge within 30s.

alice_oncall: good. step 2? dave, can you pause rollout and revert the recent kernel change? If full revert is risky, pin to previous image tag for affected nodes.

dave_runtime: pausing rollout now, pinning `quant-model-node:2026-03-15` -> `quant-model-node:2026-03-12`. Triggering cordon/evict for unhealthy pods.

dave_runtime: scaled healthy nodes +50% (3 -> 5) in eu-west pool. Evicting OOM pods for restart. Watching memory usage.

ben_sre: edge metrics: 502 rate dropped from 18% -> 3% after routing change and scale-up. Error budget trending back down.

maya_support: customer updates drafted. Posting to status page now: "Investigating increased 5xx errors on text generation endpoints; mitigation in progress; some requests routed to cached variants."

carla_prod: QA confirm: user-facing errors reduced but long-seq gen still has occasional 504s from a handful of runtime instances.

alice_oncall: next steps: 1) keep fallback route for 30m, 2) monitor for regressions, 3) run postmortem once stabilized. Assigning action owners: ben_SRE -> rollback routing after stability, dave_runtime -> full revert and memory leak investigation, carla_prod -> customer comms, maya_support -> ticket follow-ups.

ben_sre: noted. I'll keep a watch and prepare circuit revert playbook: `rollback -> traffic gradual 20% increments over 5m` with canary check on error rate <1%.

dave_runtime: collecting heap/alloc traces from affected nodes, dumping `pmap` + `dmesg` outputs to S3: `s3://redwood-incidents/2999991234/runtime-dumps/`.

alice_oncall: thanks team. Paging cleared for now but keep this channel open for 2 hours. If error rate creeps >2% re-pager.

incident-bot: Pager cleared (ack by alice_oncall). Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maya_support: I'll follow up with customers in 15m with ETA for full fix.

carla_prod: adding to postmortem: rollout gating missing mem safety check + autoscaler threshold aggressive for quantization bursts.

alice_oncall: end of live triage notes: fallback routing + scale-up mitigated the immediate 502/504 spike. Root cause investigation underway (likely rollout-induced memory pressure). Postmortem owners: dave_runtime, ben_sre.

ben_sre: attaching quick links: grafana/dashboard/gateway/errors?from=now-1h, logs/kubectl: `kubectl get pods -n runtime -o wide`.

alice_oncall: closing channel for active mitigation. Will reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
